card.name: Endings of chemical compound names
card.fires_on: The final piece of a chemical or drug name, such as -ol, -ine or -ate, when the name is split into parts. It is seen in names like 2-propanol, pyridine, benzodiazepine and sulfate.

modes.label: -ol and -ine endings
modes.description: The closing piece of a split chemical name such as propanol or pyridine.

modes.label: -ate in sulfate
modes.description: The closing piece of sulfate in drug product names.
